meta.name: Phase 3 scenario (c): asset dropout mid-horizon (SYNTHETIC)
meta.description: P3.26 deterministic scenario (c): the same pinned portfolio and seed as scenario (a) with ONE enabled fault injection — a telemetry drop on site-north-bess-1 from 12:00 to 13:00 UTC (mid-horizon). This is the telemetry-side picture of the P3.24 asset-dropout roll trigger: the scheduling layer must treat the dropped intervals as realised (MISSING quality is never silently treated as GOOD), carry the realised state forward, freeze the past, and re-optimise only the future intervals. Pinned Phase 3 scenario inputs (ledger P3.26): scheduling grid 24 h / 15-min intervals (P3.03 defaults); solver Tier 1 HiGHS 1.15.1 (MIT, pinned) via the worker adapter and Tier 2 Clarabel.rs 0.11.1 (Apache-2.0, pinned), thread_count 1, config digest recorded per solve; replay tolerance 1e-9 (DEFAULT_REPLAY_TOLERANCE); master seed 20260601 with the recorded per-asset derivation; forecast input the SYNTHETIC P3.31 fixture forecast-fixture-v1.json (scenario b: forecast-fixture-v1-error-pv-ramp.json). All values are synthetic; expected outcomes are PRE-REGISTERED in ledger/phase-03-flexibility-scheduling/25_26_tests_scenarios.md and were written before any run (they are UNRUN at authoring time).

behaviour_profile.assumptions: Synthetic baseline shape (morning and evening peaks over a near-flat night); NO metered or measured data behind it; no weather or occupancy model; NO baseline method - the baseline is a scenario-declared shape, not a computed estimate (D1/D2 open); no per-appliance disaggregation; seeded jitter only.

Deterministic daily connection windows; NO mobility or traffic model (connections follow the declared windows, not arrival-time distributions); one aggregate EV per EVSE; constant charging efficiency; NO V2G discharge in Phase 2; instantaneous transitions at window boundaries; seeded jitter only.

Active power is the aggregated SUM of the site's assets' net active power at each tick - a consistency fixture; a real PCC meter would include non-modelled load and losses. Reactive power is a configured constant under the site's declared convention.

horizon.clock_note: The scenario clock is deterministic simulation time (P0.09 s5), distinct from wall-clock time. Window and curve times are scenario-clock UTC.

cadence.default_note: 1-minute default (D-SC3): 1440 samples/asset/day - enough for freshness, staleness, bucketing, and partitioning coverage at a volume the pipeline handles without backpressure drama. Per-asset overrides possible; none used in v1.

seeds.derivation_note: One master seed plus a recorded per-asset derivation rule (D-SC4): adding an asset in a future version does not perturb existing assets' streams. The RNG algorithm and seed handling are recorded with the simulator (P2.14 step 2). Profiles without randomness (PV clear-sky, baseline shapes) consume no randomness.

faults.note: scenario (c): one mid-horizon drop on site-north-bess-1 (the P3.24 dropout trigger analogue)

expected_quality.plan_note: P3.26 pre-registered expected stored quality for scenario (c): exactly one injected window. Every tick outside the window stays GOOD with full coverage; inside the window the drop produces no frame, so the interval is covered only by the gap detector's synthesized MISSING markers (P2.04 D-T6) and the coverage accounting credits an EXPECTED gap.
